# paperclip_user (Data Source)

Reads details for a single Paperclip user by ID, email, or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "paperclip_user" "operator" {
  email = "operator@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `company_id` (String) Optional company identifier to restrict lookup to company user directory.
- `email` (String) User email address.
- `id` (String) User unique identifier.
- `name` (String) User display name.

### Read-Only

- `active_company_membership_count` (Number) Number of active company memberships.
- `image` (String) Profile image URL or asset reference.
- `is_instance_admin` (Boolean) Whether user is an instance administrator.
